posts.title: From A/B to RL (2/3): Bandits and Thompson Sampling
posts.description: Move from fixed A/B testing to online learning with Bayesian multi-armed bandits, probability matching, and Thompson sampling.

posts.title: From A/B to RL (1/3): Bayesian A/B Testing

posts.title: From A/B to RL (3/3): MENACE and Delayed Rewards
